prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: opening story scene concept art for the original 2D Arabic mobile educational adventure "Riwaq — Neighborhood of Stories", children ages 6–12.
Primary request: Generate ONE new wide landscape scene: Seed Square after a gentle rain has ended, showing EXACTLY FOUR fantasy nonhuman friends preparing their welcoming meeting place. Preserve identities from the reference character sheets.
Input images: Image 1 is the Nawwar identity reference sheet (use its front three-quarter depiction as the model; do not repeat the whole sheet). Image 2 is Lamha identity reference sheet. Image 3 is Rukn identity reference sheet. Image 4 is Wariq identity reference sheet. Image 5 is the village environment, architectural palette and painterly texture reference. These are references for a NEW scene, not edit targets.
Scene/backdrop: A cozy sunlit rounded-stone village courtyard with a broad tree, small potted plants, low wooden bench, an apricot clay house, and a sage-leaf-roof library in the background. A low arched gate leads to a visible footpath toward the reed bridge. A few rain-damp stones, warm bright daylight, fresh plants. Keep the open walking path clear.
Subjects/action: Nawwar the apricot pear creature with EXACTLY three green crown leaves and turquoise side satchel is holding a single large wooden clip and looking toward his friends. Lamha the turquoise short-furred quadruped with two leaf ears (one bent), cream fan tail with three turquoise marks, mustard backpack and clipped round magnifier is inspecting a wooden clip beside a pot, on all four short legs. Rukn the sandstone rounded-rectangle builder with three crown bumps, two arms and two pebble feet, green tool pocket, is holding a LARGE BLANK wooden welcome board beside the bench. Wariq the rounded diamond sage folded-leaf creature with five cream-tipped crown leaves, two arms/two feet and cream card pouch is holding a small open BLANK notebook.
Props: One basket, a few large wooden clips, one small pile of leaves beside the path, a pot. Objects clearly separated, not a cluttered scavenger scene.
Style/medium: Warm HAND-PAINTED 2D gouache illustration, layered tactile cut-paper shapes, gentle brush texture, soft internal shading. Follow the provided characters' materials and palette and the village image's architecture; keep every character recognizable. Fixed three-quarter game-scene viewpoint. No photorealistic camera or 3D render.
Composition/framing: Wide landscape, all FOUR characters fully visible and comfortably separated in the middle/foreground; readable faces and accessories, clear open walking area. A modest quiet upper area can accommodate future dialogue but add no UI now.
Lighting/mood: Cheerful morning teamwork and curiosity after light rain. Adventurous, welcoming, visually clear.
Constraints: Exactly one Nawwar, one Lamha, one Rukn, one Wariq, no extra characters. Opaque painted scenic background. No humans. NO text or marks on the welcome board or notebook; no lettering, labels, logo or watermark. No magical glows, halos, supernatural imagery, sacred figures, musical instruments or music symbols. Preserve character anatomy, crown counts and signature accessories. This is concept art, not a finished playable screen.
